name: Floating Chat Nova
author: akashahmed29

sections.description:
Floating Chat Nova adds a customizable floating chat button to your site that connects visitors to Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and any custom channel you define.

🆓 Free Features

  • Facebook Messenger chat button with one-click chat (m.me links)
  • Multiple Messenger accounts support
  • 2 button style presets (Style 1 & Style 2)
  • Custom welcome message & CTA bubble with delay/auto-hide timers
  • Left/right position, adjustable size & scroll offset
  • Icon & label toggle, custom colors
  • Scroll-triggered visibility
  • Custom avatar & online/offline status indicator
  • Notification badge with custom count & color
  • Show/hide independently on mobile and desktop
  • Entrance animations (fade, bounce, slide, zoom, shake)
  • Modern tabbed admin dashboard with live preview
  • Auto-save with SweetAlert2 confirmations
  • One-click reset to defaults

🚀 Pro Features

  • WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram & custom channel support
  • All 10 button style presets
  • Priority support
  • Regular updates

Upgrade any time from inside the plugin’s dashboard — Pro features unlock automatically as soon as your license is activated, no reinstall required.

Why Floating Chat Nova?

  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on your site’s performance
  • User-friendly – Intuitive admin interface with live preview
  • Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Customizable – Full control over appearance and behavior
  • Modern – Beautiful design that matches any theme

Additional Information

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data. All settings are stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the floating-chat-nova folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Chat Nova in the admin menu to configure the widget.
sections.faq:
Do I need Pro to use this plugin?

No. The free version gives you a fully working floating chat button with Messenger support, 2 button styles, and all layout/behavior/CTA options. Pro unlocks WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, a custom channel, and the remaining 8 button styles.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

From the Chat Nova settings page, click any locked style or channel, or the Upgrade to Pro button in the sidebar. This takes you to secure checkout; once your license is activated, the locked features unlock automatically.

Does upgrading require downloading a new plugin file?

No. Floating Chat Nova uses a single codebase for both Free and Pro. Activating a license simply unlocks the Pro features already built into the plugin you have installed.

How many channels are supported?

The Pro version supports 5 channels: Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and Custom Channel. The free version includes Messenger only.

Can I use multiple channels at once?

Yes! With Pro, you can display multiple channel buttons simultaneously, giving your visitors a choice of how to contact you.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes, Floating Chat Nova is fully translation-ready and supports WordPress localization.

Where can I get support?

Free users can post in the WordPress.org support forums. Pro users receive priority support directly from our team.
